title: EEGHyena2: Fixation-Inspired Joint Lexical-Grammatical Conditional Random Field for Interpretable EEG-to-Text Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.19104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A sentence is built from words that carry lexical meaning and grammatical roles, and brain activity during reading reflects both. Current EEG-to-text decoders, however, let a large language model (LLM) propose and order the words, so fluent output can reflect the LLM's prior more than the recorded EEG. In this study, we asked whether fixation-linked EEG carries lexical and grammatical evidence during natural reading and how a decoder can use such evidence. Fixation-related potential analyses showed that content and function words differ reliably in group-averaged EEG but only weakly in single words. We therefore propose EEGHyena2, a structured decoder in which a bidirectional encoder inspired by StripedHyena 2 feeds a semantic head that ranks a fixed lexicon and a part-of-speech (POS) head that predicts grammatical categories; a joint word-POS conditional random field (CRF) scores a restricted candidate lattice, and a frozen Llama-2 scor

translated_title: EEGHyena2：基于注视启发的词汇-语法联合条件随机场的可解释脑电到文本解码
translated_abstract: 句子由承载词汇意义和语法角色的词构成，而阅读过程中的大脑活动同时反映了这两方面。然而，当前的脑电到文本（EEG-to-text）解码器让大型语言模型（LLM）来提出和排列词语，因此流畅的输出可能更多反映的是LLM的先验知识，而非实际记录到的脑电信号。在本研究中，我们探究了注视相关的脑电信号在自然阅读过程中是否携带词汇和语法层面的证据，以及解码器应如何利用这些证据。注视相关电位分析表明，实词和虚词在群体平均脑电中存在可靠的差异，但在单个词层面差异较弱。因此，我们提出了EEGHyena2——一种结构化解码器，其中一个受StripedHyena 2启发的双向编码器为两个输出头提供输入：语义头对固定词表中的候选词进行排序，词性（POS）头预测语法类别；随后由一个词-词性联合条件随机场（CRF）对受限的候选词格进行评分，并由一个冻结的Llama-2模型对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出EEGHyena2解码器，利用注视相关脑电中的词汇与语法证据，通过词-词性联合条件随机场对受限候选词格进行结构化评分，从而实现更忠实于脑电信号本身（而非LLM先验）、且可解释性更强的脑电到文本解码。
en_tdlr: EEGHyena2 is a structured EEG-to-text decoder that exploits lexical and grammatical evidence in fixation-related EEG through a joint word-POS conditional random field over a restricted candidate lattice, yielding more interpretable decoding that faithfully reflects the recorded brain signals rather than LLM priors.
